name: Databento CME FX futures (nanosecond)
rate_limits: Usage based, billed per GB of uncompressed data.
what_it_has: CME Globex market data (dataset GLBX.MDP3), including currency futures, at full order book depth (MBO) with nanosecond timestamps.
simple: Paid data where every order on the futures exchange is stamped to the billionth of a second.
license_terms: Paid licence. New users get "$125 in free credits that can be used on historical market data". Live data plans are "$199 per month" (Standard), "$1,750 per month" (Plus) and "$4,500 per month" (Unlimited). Timestamps are "the number of nanoseconds since the UNIX epoch". Exchange licence terms also apply.
quality_notes: Futures, not spot FX. The only realistic route we found to nanosecond FX data at a research budget. Not yet used.

relevance.reason: The way to get true nanosecond currency data when the project needs it; the free credits cover a trial.
